Name: Joja letter fix
Author: omena007
Description: This mod fixes the bug where after passing out you get the letter telling "Last night, a Joja team member found you incapacitated..." etc. even when post Joja Mart. The letter is replaced with a one from Lewis. I thought this felt more natural ? This is my first mod so if you find something funny just tell me!
